policy_change_reason: Test dispositions 2026-10-15 (reports/forge/test-dispositions-20261015/README.md). The ten Tier 2 tests (four vector density, three image and three 100-blob tests) are held: still declared, run and shown, but not counted until one global recipe passes them together with every counted test. target_shift_recovery, the only Tier 3 test, is held because no recipe has passed it. While it is held this view counts the same tests as quality_coverage and reports HELD, never PASS. Task declarations, gates and earlier grades are unchanged; revision 2 is archived.
